meta.note: Synthetic form built from real recurring question types to exercise the pipeline. Not a real funder.

questions.text: Briefly describe your organization's history and major accomplishments.
What problem or community need does this project address?
Describe the project in detail, including timeline and how funds will be used.
Who is the target population and how many people will you serve?
What is the geographic service area?
What results are you committed to achieving, and how will you know if you succeeded?
What methods and tools will you use to evaluate success and collect data?
What are your long-term strategies for funding this work beyond the grant period?
What is your organization's annual operating budget?
Does your organization conduct an annual audit?
How much are you requesting from this grant?
Please attach a copy of your IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter.
Certify that your board and executive director approved this submission.
What is your organization's policy on merchandise returns?
